explanation.headline: Lamotrigine is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale East has 18.1 days on hand and Corvale General has 28.2 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows lamotrigine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 106 tablets of lamotrigine 150 mg at 5.8 tablets per day, providing 18.1 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 218 tablets of lamotrigine 150 mg at 7.7 tablets per day, providing 28.2 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
The second option is to buy from Advagen Pharma Limited, also not on FDA's shortage list today.
The third option is to buy from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., likewise not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
